ITEM 1 | Pale yellow scrambled egg, soft and moist with small curds and a slightly glossy sheen, spread in an irregular loose mound on the left side of the plate, roughly 12 cm across and 1.5 cm tall in places | 110
ITEM 2 | Strips of cooked bacon, reddish-brown with darker browned edges and crisp-looking fat margins, lying in an overlapping folded pile across the center of the plate, about 12 cm long and 4 cm wide, sitting on top of the scrambled egg | 45
ITEM 3 | Chunks of yellow pineapple with pale golden flesh, cut into irregular wedges and cubes about 2 to 3 cm across and 1 cm thick, slightly glistening and juicy, clustered on the right side of the plate | 150
